children: Dividend alert, Nov. 8 -- Shares of MRF, Cochin Shipyard, EAAA India and Talbros Automotive Components are likely to remain in focus in the coming week as these companies are scheduled to announce their second-quarter results for FY27. Investors will also track their board meetings for potential dividend announcements.

As the corporate earnings season reached to its last leg, Nifty and Sensex are likely to remain volatile in the coming week after the market ended flat in Diwali's Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8. Nifty 50 failed to retain the 25,000 levels and ended 0.18% lower, whereas BSE Sensex closed 28.62 points lower.
As investors prepare for the next week's trading session, here are all the details to know.
MRF, Cochin Shipyard, Nile Limited, Talbros Automotive Components, and EAA India are scheduled to announce their Q2FY27 results next week. They may also announce dividend.

MRF share price closed 1.11% higher at Rs.1,26,699.85 per share on BSE on Sunday, November 8. The stock has delivered negative 20.25% return in one year, 6.22% return in two years, and 16.92% return in three years.

Shares of Cochin Shipyard closed 1.48% higher at Rs.1238 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.32,569.40 crore on Friday. The stock has delivered 3% return in one month, but has declined 28.29% in one year, and 14.59% in two years.
Nile share price ended 6.12% higher at Rs.1397.25 per share on BSE with an MCap of Rs.419.44 crore. The stock has surged 14.26% in one year, but declined 19.47% in one year.
The company scrip closed Diwali Muhurat trading session with 2.07% gain at Rs.386.45 per share. The stock has delivered 12% return in two weeks and around 33.33% return in one year.
The company share price closed 1.31% lower at Rs.1665.5 per share on BSE with an MCap of Rs.10,769.30 crore on Friday. The stock has delivered -3.92% in 2026 so far.
